notificationConfig.adminOnlyBody: Notification configuration is available to administrators only.
notificationConfig.defaultOnHint: applies to users who haven't chosen for themselves — including new sign-ups. Turning a module off keeps everyone's saved choices, so re-enabling it restores them.

notificationConfig.title: Notification Config
notificationConfig.userTimeHint: seekers can pick their own time

notificationConfig.wordingHint: The words each notification is sent with are edited per language on Language Configs, under "push". Leave the title and description here empty to show the built-in name in each seeker's language.
